summary: A Taiwanese foundry's page for a free, open-source rounded Chinese font (jf open 粉圓, built on Kosugi Maru and Varela Round), themed on bubble tea: flat geometric cup-and-pearl illustrations, googly-eyed bird mascots and speech bubbles carry a friendly, punny voice. Unlike a foundry sales page it works as public outreach inside the corporate site's chrome: before/after toggles of the adjustments, an added-character marquee, a double-click tester, a long plain-language explanation of the OFL licence and how it differs from the company's paid licence, and donation and Messenger-subscribe buttons.
